policy.title: What Doordash, Dell and Palantir all have in common : The Indicator from Planet Money
policy.summary_zh: NPR[?] 財經節目拆解幾家被政策話題帶動的大型科技與平台公司有何共同點,重點在政府訂單與政治能見度如何轉化為估值溢價。提醒投資人分辨哪些是真實訂單、哪些只是話題。

policy.title: Pressure from the bond market hits a new level, and US stocks slide on worries about inflation
